title: Microsoft Purview: analyse endpoint DLP evidence files in Data Security Investigations
summary: Hold: the billing setup instructions omit the mandatory Data Security Investigations Admins membership needed to configure AI capacity. The roadmap details and investigation workflow are supported, with smaller corrections needed to qualifications, citations and the evidence collection path.
